title: Telling Time
label: ch:ta-telling-time
canDo: I can tell the time on the hour in Tamil and keep the hour-word மணி apart from the unrelated Sanskrit gem-word spelled exactly the same way.

payoff.summary: Say oru maṇi and iraṇṭu maṇi for one and two o'clock, then choose hour or gem by the context the word sits in; write இல்லை piece by piece and say what the puḷḷi and the left-standing ai sign do.
payoff.note: TA-C18-mani-homophone-time assesses seven of the chapter's eight atoms: maṇi and its gem homophone, clock time, the puḷḷi (TA-S08-pulli) and இ, ல, ை and இல்லை (TA-W06-write-illai), both now prerequisites. The one left out, TA-SCRIPT-RECOG-122 (த, TA-S122-letter-ta, 661), is taught by a script lesson sequenced after the payoff.
